# TaxTim SA

> > TaxTim is a South African tax filing platform that simplifies SARS eFiling and tax return submission for individuals and small businesses.

TaxTim provides automated tax return filing, calculators, and educational resources for South African taxpayers. The platform integrates directly with SARS eFiling and serves salary earners, self-employed individuals, and students.

## Key Topics

- SARS eFiling
- Tax Return Filing
- IRP5 (Salary Earners)
- Provisional Tax
- SARS Compliance
- Capital Gains Tax
- Tax Deductions
- PAYE
- Self-Employed Tax
- Income Tax
- Tax Calculators
- Vehicle Logbook
- UIF
- South Africa

## Getting Started

- [Do your Tax Return Quickly and Easily in South Africa](https://www.taxtim.com/za): TaxTim homepage for South African tax return filing and SARS eFiling
- [Login / Register to Get Started with TaxTim](https://www.taxtim.com/za/get-started): Account login and registration page for TaxTim users
- [How TaxTim Works](https://www.taxtim.com/za/how-tim-works): Explanation of TaxTim's automated tax filing and SARS submission process

## Tax Filing & Tools

- [Tax Calculators](https://www.taxtim.com/za/calculators): Tax calculators for salary, capital gains, retirement planning
- [My Returns](https://www.taxtim.com/za/my-returns): User dashboard for managing tax returns and filing
- [Vehicle Logbook App for Recording Work Trips](https://www.taxtim.com/za/services/mobile-vehicle-logbook): Mobile app for tracking work travel expenses and SARS compliance
- [My Documents](https://www.taxtim.com/za/my-documents): User account section for document storage and management

## Tax Guides & Education

- [Tax Guide For Beginners](https://www.taxtim.com/za/guides/tax-beginners-guide): Beginner's guide to South African tax filing and SARS requirements
- [Tax guide for salary earners (IRP5)](https://www.taxtim.com/za/guides/tax-guide-for-salary-earners-irp5): Guide for IRP5 salary earners on tax deductions and filing
- [Provisional Tax](https://www.taxtim.com/za/guides/provisional-tax): Guide to provisional tax, IRP6 forms, and self-employed tax filing
- [Do I need to file a tax return?](https://www.taxtim.com/za/tax-guides/chats/do-i-need-to-file-tax-return): Interactive eligibility checker for SARS tax filing requirements
- [Student Assist - Teaching Students about Tax](https://www.taxtim.com/za/services/student-assist): Educational platform for tax and accounting students at UCT, Wits

## Support & Resources

- [Help with South African Tax](https://www.taxtim.com/za/help): Help center with guides, tutorials, and tax tools for SARS eFiling
- [Frequently asked questions](https://www.taxtim.com/za/faq): FAQ covering TaxTim features, SARS eFiling integration, and tax filing
- [Contact TaxTim](https://www.taxtim.com/za/contact-us): Customer support contact page for TaxTim assistance

## Account Management

- [Profile Settings](https://www.taxtim.com/za/profile): User profile management for TaxTim account settings
